rationale: Evaluate the literal nonsignificance-implies-equivalence advice rule on a fixed archive of authentic retrieval outputs. This is a bounded replay diagnostic of a known inferential error, not a new statistical result or evidence of actual user adoption/cost-based harm.
research_question: For everyfixed official Round5 candidate pair evaluated on all50topics, what paireduncertainty is hidden by declaring nonsignificance functionalequivalence? A separate25/25topic split asks how that statement transfers to independentlyheldouttopic observations.

source_task.candidate_selection: All126official submission links frozen before performance computation, sortedrun_tag. No score reports or rankings used.
source_task.source_limit: NIST URLs are public release endpoints rather than Git revisions; downloaded compressed and uncompressed bytes, ETag/Last-Modified and exact SHA256 must be pinned before comparative scoring.

SecondaryHolm confirmationp across all7875planned pairs can flag resolveddifferences for the25/25diagnostic; raw multiplecomparisons are not familywise evidence. Missingpairs have no p-values/certification.

primary_test.scope: Signed-rank test of symmetric paired-difference distribution aboutzero, not a test of practicalequivalence or uniquely a meandifference.
primary_test.auto_method_limit: Pinned SciPyauto uses exact/null approximations based on sample/ties/zeros; expose nonzeroN and retain approximation limitations.

uncertainty.unit: Topic; retain same topic draw acrossallcandidatecolumns. Resample within split×topic-era strata. Full50interval resampling uses allthreeera strata.
uncertainty.minimum_symmetric_interval_margin: max(abs(CI_lower),abs(CI_upper)); merely smallest symmetric margin containing this conditionalinterval.
uncertainty.no_practical_margin: No externally justified universal nDCG practical-equivalence margin established. Do not inventone, choose one afterresults, or assert practicalequivalence from the frontier.
uncertainty.inference_limits: Conditional finite-topic intervals depend on exchangeability within coarseera strata, pooledjudgments and fixedsystems; no inference to alluserqueries or independentteam/modelpopulations.
uncertainty.draw_order: Full50 then discovery25 then confirmation25; eachblock resamples withinits topic-era strata with sharedtopicdraws acrossmodels.
